name: FortnitePixelDash17
author: FDAteam
description: Time an entrance into the reverse gravity portal as the ship at 7% to be able to fall above the gameplay through the cone decoration. Shortly after at 7.8%, time a small hold to avoid a large hitbox Fall up until 18% where you can fly at a constant position until you get teleported back into the level where you need to time the invisible pads at 22% and then hold to go above the level again. Hold until around 32% and stay at the position even while your icon is offscreen. Release at 50% until you see your icon again where you can then hold until your icon is slightly below the ceiling where you can stay at a constant position until the end from there.
